common.authority: This workspace records control intent and inspects S223 facts. The external run-paper-runtime process owns leases, recovery, and actual execution progress.

list.title: Paper Runtimes
list.description: Discover durable runtimes while keeping requested and observed state visibly separate.
list.emptyMessage: Change the exact filters or create a runtime from a nonterminal execution Order.
list.caption: Durable Paper Runtimes in backend order

create.title: Create a durable runtime
create.description: Bind one exact nonterminal M34 execution Order without starting it.
create.authority: Creation binds existing M34 authority only. It does not Start, Step, claim a lease, or run recovery.
create.candidatesDescription: Only Orders that the backend reports as nonterminal are selectable; ordering and eligibility facts are preserved exactly.
create.noCandidatesMessage: No backend Order facts are available on this page.
create.validationOrder: Select one backend-reported nonterminal execution Order.
create.validationActor: Actors must be exact, nonblank values without leading or trailing whitespace.
create.validationPolicy: The runtime policy ID must be an exact nonblank value.
create.validationVersion: The runtime policy version must be a nonnegative integer.
create.noAutoStart: The runtime was not auto-Started. Use its detail page for an explicit lifecycle request.

detail.title: Durable Paper Runtime
detail.loading: Loading runtime, health, reconciliation, and durable evidence.
detail.authority: Refresh performs GETs only. Lifecycle buttons record control intent through S223; the browser never hosts the runner or mutates leases, Work, checkpoints, M31, or M32.
detail.bindingDescription: Exact runtime, M34 Order, account, replay, session, actor, and policy binding.
detail.lifecycleDescription: Requested state is Founder intent; observed state changes only when durable runtime evidence says it did.
detail.requestedHelp: What the Founder most recently requested.
detail.observedHelp: What the durable runtime has actually observed.
detail.healthDescription: Lease health is operational wall-clock evidence, not market time. Unowned or expired while running is an attention condition, not proof of execution failure.
detail.reconciliationDescription: Historical coherence and continuation freshness remain distinct backend facts.
detail.continuationStale: Continuation is stale, but coherent historical inspection remains visible. The Web UI does not auto-repair or rebase authority.

controls.title: Founder controls
controls.description: Each request uses the currently displayed binding digest, row version, and command actor.
controls.inspectionOnly: Completed and blocked runtimes allow inspection and Refresh only.
controls.stopCooperative: Stop is cooperative and does not cancel an M34 Step already in progress.
controls.runnerNotice: Start and Resume do not themselves execute. The external run-paper-runtime process owns runner execution and actual recovery.
controls.noExecutionProof: Acceptance is not proof of an active runner, observed running, Work, Attempt, Fill, settlement, or replay progression. Refresh later to inspect returned facts.

evidence.auditDescription: Ordered lifecycle, ownership, Work, observation, completion, and block events.
evidence.auditCaption: Runtime audit events in backend order
evidence.workDescription: Runner-created Work includes the exact expected execution version and M34 Step command identity.
evidence.checkpointsDescription: Observed M34 Attempt, optional Fill and settlement, and replay post-cursor facts.
